1.w: And YHWH answered Job out of the whirlwind, and He said:

2.w: “Who [is] this darkening counsel with words lacking knowledge?

3.w: Gird up your loins now like a man, and I will question you, and you shall answer Me.

4.w: Where were you at my founding of the earth? Declare it if you know [with] understanding.

5.w: Who set its measurements? Surely you must know! Or who stretched over it a line?

6.w: On what were its bases made to sink [in], or who cast the stone of its corner,

7.w: at the singing together [by] the stars of the morning, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

8.w: Or [who] shut in the sea with doors, at its coming forth in its bursting from the womb,

9.w: in my setting [for] the cloud its garment, and [for] the dark cloud its swaddling band,

10.w: when I broke forth over it My decree, and set in place a bar and doors,

11.w: and I said, ‘Up to here you may come, and you shall not go further; and here shall be set the pride of your waves’?

12.w: have you commanded the morning from your days, [and] made the dawn to know its place,

13.w: for [it] to take hold of the edges of the earth, and the wicked be shaken out of it?

14.w: It is turned over like clay under a seal, and they stand out like a garment.

15.w: And their light is withheld from the wicked, and the arm upraised is broken.

16.w: Have you come to the springs of the sea, or in search of the depths have you walked about?

17.w: Have the gates of death been uncovered to you, or have you seen the doors of the shadow of death?

18.w: Have you comprehended to the breadths of the earth? Declare it if you know all of it.

19.w: Where [is] this way [to] the dwelling of light? And of darkness, where [is] this its place,

20.w: that you may take it to its border, that you may know the paths [to] its home?

21.w: You must know [it], for you were born then, and the number of your days [is] great!

22.w: Have you come to the treasury of snow, or have you seen the treasury of hail,

23.w: that I have held back for a time of trouble, for a day of battle and war?

24.w: Where [is] this, the way light is apportioned? The east wind is scattered over the earth.

25.w: Who has divided out a channel for the flood, or a path for the lightning of the thunderings,

26.w: to make rain come upon a land without man, a desert without man in it,

27.w: to satisfy the waste and the desolation, and to make sprout the shoot of the grass?

28.w: Is there a father for the rain? Or who has begotten the drops of dew?

29.w: From whose womb comes forth the ice? And the frost of the heavens, who gives birth to it?

30.w: Like stone, the waters hide themselves, and the face of the deep is seized.

31.w: Can you bind the chains of the Pleiades, or can you open the cords of Orion?

32.w: Can you bring forth Mazzaroth in its time? Or can you lead out the Bear with her cubs?

33.w: Do you know the ordinances of the heavens? Or can you set its rule over the earth?

34.w: Can you raise to the cloud your voice, and an abundance of waters will cover you?

35.w: Can you send out lightnings, that they may go and say to you, ‘Behold us’?

36.w: Who has put wisdom in the inner parts? Or who has given to the heart understanding?

37.w: Who can count the clouds by wisdom? Or the water skins of the heavens, who can tilt,

38.w: in the pouring of the dust into a mass, and the clods clinging together?

39.w: Can you hunt prey for a lion, or satisfy the life of young lions,

40.w: when they crouch in the dens, dwelling in a thicket, lying in wait in [it]?

41.w: Who provides to the raven its food when its children cry out to God and wander for lack of food?
